entities.name: Uchida Kuichi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Uchida Kuichi  was a pioneering Japanese photographer from Nagasaki. He was greatly respected as a portrait photographer and was the only photographer granted a sitting to photograph the Emperor Meiji.
